//! One-shot fixture writer. Not part of the product. Deleted after the
//! pre-bump index is saved; the source is kept as generate.rs.txt.
fn main() {
    let out = std::path::PathBuf::from(std::env::args().nth(1).expect("output directory"));
    let engine = ledgerful::search::TantivySearchEngine::open_or_create(&out).expect("open");
    let schema = engine.schema();
    let path_field = schema.get_field("path").expect("path");
    let content_field = schema.get_field("content").expect("content");
    let line_count_field = schema.get_field("line_count").expect("line_count");
    let language_field = schema.get_field("language").expect("language");
    let trigrams_field = schema.get_field("trigrams").expect("trigrams");

    let content = "fn alpha() {}";
    let trigrams = content
        .chars()
        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        .windows(3)
        .map(|w| w.iter().collect::<String>())
        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        .join(" ");

    let mut writer = engine.get_writer(15_000_000).expect("writer");
    let mut doc = tantivy::TantivyDocument::default();
    doc.add_text(path_field, "src/alpha.rs");
    doc.add_text(content_field, content);
    doc.add_u64(line_count_field, 1);
    doc.add_text(language_field, "rust");
    doc.add_text(trigrams_field, &trigrams);
    writer.add_document(doc).expect("add");
    writer.commit().expect("commit");
    ledgerful::search::write_stamp(&out).expect("stamp");
}
